title: Refresh changed Engram declarations after warm Claude queue actions
outcome: An explicit Human Send that wakes an older ordinary User head or a selected Resume can reuse warm Claude. The explicit route defers checking whether .engram-project was added or removed, so this turn can continue with the runtime's prior descriptor until an independent refresh detects the change. Decide and test a deferred reconciliation that keeps warm enqueue responsive and avoids sibling runtime invalidation.
acceptance: A warm explicit action continues without waiting for a declaration read, and a subsequent reconciliation observes a changed project declaration with a documented runtime effect.
Reconciliation preserves queue ownership and warms only the intended session's next launch, with no sibling reset caused by the explicit action.
